# Compare the hour, not just the check.

> Free booth rent vs commission calculator for hair stylists, barbers, and nail techs. Compare take-home and hourly pay on your own book after rent, card fees, backbar, and unpaid hours.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
